'''Sparkit''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Firefox]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Sparkit never misses a chance to get food. Nobody knows just how many snacks are already stashed away in that fluffy tail."

Sparkit is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Sparkit is a small, round quadruped animal that resembles a fox. It is primarily characterized by its poppy red and off-white color palette. It has a bean-shaped body with a large head that transitions directly into the torso without a visible neck. It also has a bushy tail that is almost half the size of its body. Its eyes appear to be perpetually shut.

Sparkit's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with light blue, and off-white becomes pure white.

==Evolution Trial==
Sparkit's evolution trial begins once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Firefox]] you need to complete the following task:
* Shoot 2,400 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "[[Zapup]] could just be a Sparkit dyed yellow. It's time to evolve so you can tell them apart."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/2026, its bio description said: "When hunger strikes, Sparkit puts on the cutest act for the trainer, secretly hiding any candy beneath the tail."

== Combat Strategy ==
[[File:Sparkit Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Sparkit's attack range]]
As a strong Fire DPS Tatari recommended for early game, Sparkit can effortlessly clear a Grass Zobo lane.

Position it behind a Tank and beside a Support in order to maximize its efficiency. You must evolve Sparkit to Firefox, a stronger Tatari to faster stage progression.
